title: Vibrant Sweet Algerian Mitsuba Bowl
description: A sweet and crumbly post-workout Algerian dish featuring mitsuba, served in a lacquerware bowl, dairy-free friendly.
instructions: In a mortar, pound the chopped mitsuba with a pestle until well bruised and fragrant.
In a large bowl, mix together the almond flour, coconut sugar, and salt.
Add the pitted dates to the bowl and mix until well combined with the dry ingredients.
In a small bowl, whisk together the almond butter, lemon juice, and water until smooth.
Add the wet ingredients to the dry ingredients and mix until a crumbly dough forms.
Fold in the chopped pistachios and bruised mitsuba into the dough.
Scoop the dough into a lacquerware bowl and serve immediately.
Garnish with additional chopped pistachios and mitsuba if desired.
